activity.notes: Tenoch is modeled as an early Mexica leader associated with the foundation and consolidation of Mexico-Tenochtitlan, not as a tlatoani. INAH identifies Tenoch as the leader who consolidated the Mexica state and associates his death with 1363; Acamapichtli belongs to the later dynastic tlatoani sequence. The c.1325-c.1363 interval is therefore explicitly approximate.
